classes_covered: secrets shipped in public JS bundles (L1 since v1.3)
directory listing / risky HTTP methods / exposed API docs (L2)
Supabase live anon RLS probe (L3 v0.4 — read-only GET)
restricted differential access check (L3 v1.0 — --active-tests, GET-only, verified ownership, owner identities)
classes_not_covered: authenticated-area testing & business-logic flaws beyond the restricted differential check
injection testing (XSS/SQLi canaries — delegated: init-zap generates the ZAP baseline config, v1.0 decision)
full DAST / fuzzing (by design — delegated to the generated ZAP config)
server internals, databases, queues (black-box view only — pair with Codebase Mode)

score_breakdown.note: Low-confidence findings and INFO do not deduct. Repeats of the same root cause add +10% each, capped at 2× the severity weight (v1.3).

findings.title: Site served over plain HTTP (no TLS)

evidence.note: every request — including session cookies — travels in cleartext

findings.fix: Serve over HTTPS (terminate TLS at the edge/provider, redirect http→https, enable HSTS once stable).

findings.title: Live anon read returned rows from "profiles" — RLS not effective in production

evidence.masked: GET /rest/v1/profiles?select=*&limit=1 → 200 rows[] (anon key from public JS of http://127.0.0.1:61787)

findings.fix: Enable RLS on "profiles" and add a policy, or revoke anon access: this live probe read real rows with the public anon key. Pair with Codebase Mode SUPA-R rules on the repo's migrations.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy header missing
findings.fix: Serve a Content-Security-Policy header (start with a report-then-enforce rollout; script-src 'self', no unsafe-inline for new code). Code map: server bootstrap or reverse proxy config (nginx / platform headers settings).

findings.title: Clickjacking protection missing (no X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
findings.fix: Serve X-Frame-Options: DENY (or CSP frame-ancestors 'none') so the site cannot be framed by attacker pages. Code map: server bootstrap or reverse proxy config (nginx / platform headers settings).

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options header missing
findings.fix: Serve X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on all responses. Code map: server bootstrap or reverse proxy config (nginx / platform headers settings).

findings.title: Referrer-Policy header missing
findings.fix: Serve Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or stricter). Code map: server bootstrap or reverse proxy config (nginx / platform headers settings).

findings.title: Permissions-Policy header missing
findings.fix: Serve a Permissions-Policy restricting camera/microphone/geolocation to none (or first-party only). Code map: server bootstrap or reverse proxy config (nginx / platform headers settings).

findings.title: Supabase data API enumerates 2 table(s) with the anon key
findings.fix: Informational — anon key is public by design; the control is RLS. Live row probes below report which tables actually return data.

findings.title: Live anon read of "audit_log" rejected (HTTP 401) — RLS holding
findings.fix: Documented-correct behavior — keep the policy tests in Codebase Mode green.
